description:
***hackajob** 
 is collaborating with
 **Barclays** 
 to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.*
 Join us as a Software Engineer at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Software Engineer
 **,** 
 you should have experience with:
   

  

* Proficient with Python.
* Good understanding of GenAI concepts.
* Experience in AWS cloud.
* Expertise in NLP and conversational AI technologies, with hands\-on experience building and optimizing chatbots or virtual assistants.
* Understanding of web service development experience using REST services/APIs, JSON, XML .


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Experience in core AIML concepts.
* Experience in TDD concepts.
* Understanding on architectural low\-level and high\-level diagram concepts.
* Understanding of Docker Jenkins, other Cloud Platforms.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Software Engineer (JavaScript)
description:
**Life at UiPath**
 The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category\-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
   

  

 To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self\-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast\-moving, fast\-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
   

  

 Could that be you?
   

  

**Your mission**
 To help build the Peak platform \- a new system of intelligence that allows companies to
   

  

 quickly harness the power of AI.
   

  

**What You'll Do At UiPath**
 Based in Jaipur, you will work in a highly collaborative team on cutting\-edge technologies
   

  

 in a supportive and fast\-moving environment. You will play a key role in building and
   

  

 scaling the Peak platform and onboarding new clients.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Continually updating your technical knowledge and skills to ensure Peak are using the most relevant tools and techniques
* Writing production\-quality code and demonstrating strong problem\-solving skills through coding and design discussions.
* Utilize your extensive experience with Typescript, Nodejs, AWS and kubernetes to contribute to the development of high\-quality software solutions
* Work closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful delivery of projects.
* Effectively communicate technical concepts and project updates to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Supporting the onboarding of new clients to the Peak platform
* Creating technical specifications and test plans.
* Writing, testing, reviewing, and refactoring code to maintain high quality and maintainability.
* Exploring new technologies and advancement in cloud and AI tech.
* Coaching and mentoring junior team members, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.
* Contributing to AI\-powered features, including integrations with Large Language Models (LLMs).


**What You'll Bring To The Team**
* We are building a team of world\-class engineers in Jaipur, focused on solving real\-world problems with practical AI. 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack development.
* Strong experience with React, Typescript, Nodejs, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes.
* Preferred experience in Kafka, Kubernetes and Python.
* Experience with one or more Database systems, such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB.
* Strong understanding of full\-stack development, including front\-end, back\-end, and database management.
* Ability to write clean, well\-tested, and extendable code that is easy to maintain.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical topics clearly and concisely.
* Experience with LLMs and GenAI concepts such as RAG, prompt engineering, building agentic workflows etc. is a plus.
* Knowledge of Python and exposure to Machine Learning tooling \& fundamentals is a plus.


 Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
   

  

 Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office\-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
   

  

 We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
 Kobie, a 35\-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi\-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data\-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Participate in all phases of Agile methodology (planning, grooming, coding sprint items)
* Gain knowledge and control of our loyalty platform integration points (live API's, Batch, Queue based processing)
* Participate in design sessions; work with product owners and team members to solve acceptance criteria
* Build and maintain all configuration and business logic rule documentation
* Assist other team members through coaching and mentoring
* Promote and demonstrate good coding practice and patterns for the team
* Set accurate time estimates and scope of work for tasks and/or projects assigned to you
* Fill information gaps as needed to accomplish gaps
* Develop simple solutions to complex problems
* Suggest innovative new ways to improve processes and/or components of work
* Effectively work with other groups and third parties


**What You Need To Be Successful**
* 3\+ years of experience designing and developing applications and components using Java and Spring (Prefer JDK 11\+ with Spring Boot)
* 3\+ years of experience in front\-end web application development
* 1\+ years of experience designing and developing applications using Angular (Prefer version 10\+)
* 1\+ years of experience developing RESTful services using JSON
* Experience developing microservice cloud applications (Oracle, AWS, or Azure)
* 1\+ years of experience developing SQL multi\-table queries, inserts, and updates (Prefer Oracle / PostgreSQL)
* Experience tuning SQL statements with execution explain plans
* Familiarity with Agile (e.g., Scrum Process)
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field is preferred
* Experience developing Loyalty, Accounting, or Banking applications
* Message Queues (RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, Kafka Streams)
* Building Docker containers and configuring Kubernetes clusters (kubectl, Docker for Desktop)
* Build Management tools (Bitbucket/Git, Gradle, Bamboo)


**About Kobie**
 Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth\-focused culture.
   

  

 As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy\-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award\-winning culture to a new region \- creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
   

  

 We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
   

  

 Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
   

  

 To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well\-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work \- recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work\-life balance.
   

  

 As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
   

  

 Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Software Engineer 2
description:
We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our growing Gurugram Products \& Technology team to develop and expand core parts of a new platform we are building to make it easier for customers to build AI applications using MongoDB.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer on this new team, you will be responsible for developing cutting edge technologies related to enabling deployment at scale of AI applications. You will take on challenging, high\-visibility projects that improve and enhance the performance, scalability, and reliability of the distributed systems infrastructure for this new product. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high\-quality software and living MongoDB cultural values every day – we value intellectual curiosity and honesty, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Position Expectations
   

  

* Writing and testing software in commonly used high level programming languages, such as Go, Python, Java, Javascript and others.
* Design, build and deliver well\-tested core pieces of the platform in collaboration with other vested parties
* Maintaining a balance between delivering software and performing research and development
* Working closely with cross functional teams to create end user features that deliver quality software to our clients
* A workplace culture where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work \- we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation


**Qualifications**
* Must have completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Have a foundation in computer science theory, with competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design
* Minimum experience of 6 months to 3 years, internship experience is also accepted
* Proficient in one of our commonly used languages which include Go, Python, Java, Javascript, C\+\+, or comparable high level programming languages
* Experience writing and testing software whether as part of an internship, in a personal project, in a coding competition, or for research
* Good verbal and written technical communication skills, desire to collaborate with colleagues
* Eager to learn, with a strong technical background


**About MongoDB**

title: Software Development Engineer I, SMB
description:
**About Flexport:**
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes \- from emerging brands to Fortune 500s \- use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
   

  

 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 Investing your time with Flexport means keeping pace with a rapidly growing business, learning new skills, and seeking opportunities to fill the gap. We appreciate your contributions to making Flexport an amazing place to work and we encourage upwards or lateral movement and transfers that align with current business needs.
   

  

 Exceptional software development is integral in allowing us to fulfil our mission of making global trade easier for everyone. At Flexport you’ll develop systems that are at the forefront of reshaping the entire logistics \& supply chain industries. The SMB organization strives to increase Flexport’s efficiency and effectiveness by providing self\-serve platforms that reduce complexity for small and medium businesses. We solve foundational engineering challenges with the added complexity of the logistics domain that Flexport is in after merging Deliverr technology.
   

  

 Here are some of the things we work on:
   

  

* Replenishment to FBA, WFS \- Building the next generation of automated replenishment systems as merchant scale with Flexport Reserve Storage, with the promise of lean inventory and no stock\-outs.
* Upstream Inventory Management \- Creating a single platform for merchants to manage their inventory and plan their supply chain in the self\-serve portal with all the insights and recommendations from Flexport.


* Wholesale and Retail orders \- Building the distribution capabilities to brick\-and\-mortar retailers and wholesalers. This includes onboarding, ingestion, digitalization, and outbounds of bulk orders.


* Warehouse Operational excellence \- Improving the freight booking process and communication across operations, clients, carriers, and partners for inbound, outbound, and all related shipments from or to US warehouse facilities at Flexport.


**You will:**
* Take on complex product initiatives and run them to completion with minimal supervision.
* Design flexible, maintainable and scalable code.
* Safeguard code quality on your team, reviewing others’ code with an eye to performance and maintainability.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to execute against the vision and roadmap
* Work closely with designers and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.
* Be part of a close\-knit engineering team that ships new code with every PR, every day.
* Geek out about supply\-chain, shipping and logistics. (We do this often.)


**You should have:**
* 1\+ years experience writing software and a strong engineering background.
* A love of simple, well\-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
* Ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business stakeholders, product managers, and engineers alike.
* A self\-starter attitude. When you see a problem, you solve it.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Typescript, Java, or JS.


**Our Stack:**
 Our continuous releases are integrated with Buildkite and Github. On the frontend, we create our views with React, manage data flow with redux, and test our application with Jest. On the backend, it is in Node.js, typescript and Java. Our data persisted in mostly RDS and Algolia. Our stack is hosted on AWS using Docker.
   

  

**Worried about not having any logistics experience?**
* Don’t be! We’re building the first Operating System for Global Trade. That’s why it’s incredibly important for us to bring people from diverse backgrounds and experiences together with our industry veterans to help move the freight forwarding industry forward.
* What’s freight forwarding and why does it matter? Freight forwarding is the coordination and shipment of goods from one place to another and it’s what makes global trade possible. Flexport is on a mission to make global trade easier for everyone because we believe it can help connect the world and break down economic barriers.
* We know this industry is complex. That’s why we invest in education starting day one with Flexport Academy, a one\-week intensive onboarding program designed specifically to set every new Flexport employee up for success.


 Commitment to Equal Opportunity
   

  

 At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants
   

  

 Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

title: Associate Director, Organizational Systems Analyst
description:
**About the Role:**  

**Grade Level (for internal use):** 12
  
  

**The Role:**  

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate Director, Organizational Systems Analysis, to join S\&P Global’s People team. In this role, you will help build and deliver data\-driven and Tech/AI\-enabled people team solutions to our leaders and our people. Particular product focus will be in team effectiveness, upskilling \& reskilling, job\-redesign, career mapping, training, recognition, and engagement of our people with a skills\-based, people forward approach. You will be on the cutting edge of embedding AI\-, analytical, and digital delivery of our people capabilities!
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Organizational Systems and Analytics
  
  

Collaborate with other Workforce Planning \& Future of work teams to deliver critical job and work re\-design engagements to support business operating model, process re\-engineering, and org design plans.
  
  

Conduct systems analysis on organizational data to identify trends, patterns, and insights related to ‘people workflows’
  
  

Partner with HR business partners and leadership to translate business questions into talent strategy frameworks and provide data\-driven recommendations
  
  

Lead special analytics projects that drive organizational effectiveness and support global business objectives that can be solved with automated systems.
  
  

Provides technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing organizational and talent systems and procedures that are cost effective, scalable and meet user requirements.
  
  

**Internal Consulting Services:**  

Support internal consulting engagements to People Partners, Finance Partners, and business stakeholders in achieving their people and financial objectives.
  
  

Work with Talent, Total Rewards, and other People functions to guide and optimize talent strategy for consulting engagements.
  
  

Address specific organizational challenges by supporting tailored solutions and strategic advice in collaboration with people team partners.
  
  

Provides support of multi\-functional efforts to identify, interpret and produce recommendations based on company systems needs.
  
  

Advises business groups by providing technical and strategic direction to identify and address business issues and opportunities.
  
  

**Data \& Analytics Partnership:**  

Partner with People Data and People Analytics to build data and analytics to guide KPIs and ROI for the organizational effectiveness solutions.
  
  

Work with relevant vendor partners to scope and manage execution of roll\-out, product enhancement, and integration plans
  
  

Collaborate with people data, people technology and AI\+ strategists to deliver AI tooling to various people team stakeholder
  
  

Work closely with People Analytics team to contribute to reports, dashboards, models, and tools that enhance the usage of workforce and organizational analytics as well as the integration of benchmarks, workforce planning best practices, and alternative data sets
  
  

**What We’re Looking For:****Qualifications:**  

Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Psychology, Business, or related field
  
  

10\+ years of experience in HR analytics, people analytics, or business intelligence roles
  
  

Proficiency in analytical tools and programming languages such as R, Python, SQL, or similar statistical software
  
  

Experience with data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, or similar business intelligence tools
  
  

Strong understanding of HR metrics, workforce analytics, and people data interpretation
  
  

Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex analytical findings to non\-technical stakeholders
  
  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**  

Master's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Industrial Psychology, or related quantitative field
  
  

Experience with advanced statistical techniques including predictive modeling, machine learning, or multivariate analysis
  
  

Knowledge of HR information systems such as Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar HRIS platforms
  
  

Previous experience in consulting or advisory roles supporting business decision\-making through analytics
  
  

What’s In It For You?
  
  

**Our Mission:**  

Advancing Essential Intelligence.
  
  

**Our People:**  

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.
  
  

**Our Values:**  

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership
  
  

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  

**Benefits:**  

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S\&P Global.
  
  

**Our benefits include:**  

**Health \& Wellness:** Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
  
  

**Flexible Downtime:** Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
  
  

**Continuous Learning:** Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
  
  

**Invest in Your Future:** Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company\-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
  
  

**Family Friendly Perks:** It’s not just about you. S\&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best\-in class benefits for families.
  
  

**Beyond the Basics:** From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

description:
**Date:** 11 Apr 2026


**Location:** Gurugram, India


**Company:** Sterlite Power Transmission Limited


**Position Title**
------------------



Manager \- Compliance and Legal

**Purpose of Role**
-------------------



The Compliance Officer is responsible for monitoring and ensuring statutory and regulatory compliance across corporate functions and project sites of the organization.



The role involves overseeing compliance reporting, interpreting regulatory requirements applicable to the power transmission sector, assessing applicability of new laws and regulations, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely compliance across locations.

**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------


* Monitor and ensure statutory and regulatory compliance across corporate functions, project sites, and operational units in accordance with applicable central, state, and sector\-specific laws.
* Oversee compliance reporting through the compliance management system and ensure that designated users across locations complete compliance filings accurately and within prescribed timelines.
* Monitor compliance dashboards, track pending actions, and follow up with responsible departments or site teams to ensure timely closure of compliance obligations.
* Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on compliance requirements and resolve queries relating to interpretation or applicability of statutory provisions.
* Conduct periodic compliance reviews across corporate departments and project sites to assess implementation status and identify potential risks or gaps.
* Prepare and submit compliance review reports to management highlighting key compliance risks, gaps, and recommended corrective actions.
* Assess the applicability of new laws, regulations, and regulatory updates relevant to the power transmission sector, including those related to electricityregulations, land acquisition, environmental approvals, and project development.
* Review compliance implications arising from new projects, transmission line construction, substations, expansions, or operational changes.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Legal, Project Development, Engineering, Finance, HR, EHS, and Procurement to ensure timely implementation of applicable compliance requirements.
* Track amendments in central and state laws relevant to infrastructure and power transmission operations and communicate regulatory updates and their impact to management and relevant teams.
* Support statutory inspections, regulatory filings, and interactions with government authorities, regulators, and auditors as required.
* Assist in internal and external compliance audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain compliance documentation, records, and reporting frameworks at the corporate level.
**Critical Success Factors \- Essential**
-----------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Law, or a related discipline (LLB preferred).
* 5\-7 years of experience in corporate compliance, regulatory compliance, or legal/compliance roles within infrastructure, power, energy, or related sectors.
**Critical Success Factors \- Desirable**

* Strong understanding of statutory and regulatory compliance frameworks in India
* Ability to interpret laws and assess regulatory applicability across projects and locations
* Strong analytical, documentation, and reporting skills
* Effective communication and stakeholder management across departments and sites
* Attention to detail and strong follow\-up capabilities
* Ability to work independently and manage compliance monitoring at a corporate level

**Objective of the Role:**

The HR Manager will be responsible for driving HR Operations and overseeing Talent Acquisition (20%), while ensuring strong governance, compliance, employee engagement, and cultural alignment. The role demands hands\-on expertise in HR operations, audit compliance (ISO, SOC 2\), performance management, employee relations, and policy framing, along with the ability to leverage AI tools and HR chatbots for operational efficiency.

**Job Description:**

1\. **HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management:**

* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations, including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, role changes, and exits.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records, HR MIS, and documentation.
* Oversee HR workflows to ensure consistency, compliance, and efficiency.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational HR matters.

2\. **Policy Framework, Rules \& Regulations:**

* Address employee concerns and conflicts in a fair and timely manner.
* Ensure policies are aligned with organizational goals, legal requirements, and compliance standards.
* Communicate policies effectively and ensure organization\-wide adherence.
* Periodically review policies to support evolving business and workforce needs.

3\. **Compliance, Audit \& Governance:**

* Ensure HR compliance with ISO standards, SOC 2 controls, and other regulatory/audit requirements
* Prepare and maintain audit documentation, evidence registers, and compliance trackers.
* Coordinate and support internal and external audits; ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Work closely with InfoSec, Legal, and Management teams to ensure governance alignment.

4\. **Performance Management System (PMS):**

* Drive and manage the Performance Management process, including goal setting, reviews, appraisals, and feedback cycles.
* Ensure fair, transparent, and consistent performance evaluation practices.
* Support managers in performance discussions, improvement plans, and capability development.
* Track performance metrics and provide actionable insights to leadership.

5\. **Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution:**

* Act as a trusted partner for employees and managers to address workplace concerns.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and conflict resolution with sensitivity and fairness.
* Ensure adherence to disciplinary processes, corrective actions, and documentation standards.
* Foster a positive and respectful work environment

6\. **Culture Building \& Employee Engagement:**

* Drive initiatives that strengthen organizational culture, values, and employee engagement.
* Promote collaboration, transparency, and ownership across teams.
* Support leadership in embedding cultural values into daily operations and people practices.
* Design and execute engagement initiatives aligned with company culture and growth goals.

7\. **Talent Acquisition Oversight:**

* Oversee recruitment strategy, workforce planning, and hiring timelines.
* Guide recruiters on role requirements, interview frameworks, and hiring quality.
* Participate in final interviews for key positions and provide decision support.
* Monitor hiring metrics and continuously improve recruitment effectiveness.

8\. **HR Technology, AI \& Automation:**

* Leverage HRMS platforms, AI tools, and HR chatbots to streamline HR operations and employee support.
* Implement automation for onboarding, policy dissemination, employee queries, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to enhance HR efficiency through technology and digital tools.

**Skills \& Competencies Functional \& Technical Skills:**

* Strong expertise in HR operations, compliance, audits, and governance.
* Practical exposure to ISO, SOC 2, and compliance\-driven environments.
* Ability to design and enforce policies, SOPs, and internal regulations.

**Soft Skills \& Behavioral Competencies:**

* Quick action and problem\-solving abilities in operational scenarios.

**Project Engineer (Execution \& Site Support)**

Job Title: Project Engineer – Site Execution \& Systems Support

Location: Village Majara (8km for Ahmedgarh), dist. Ludhiana, Punjab (full\-time on\-site)

Reporting To: Senior Project Engineer

Experience: 2–5 years (fresher with strong internship/project experience in industrial construction will be considered)

Joining: By May 2026

**About the Company \& Project**

Carbon Secure India Pvt. Ltd. (CSI) is a fast\-growing climate\-tech startup building a large\-scale biochar carbon removal project on a 60 acre site.

Using paddy straw and rice husk as feed stock, we operate artisanal kilns scaled to industrial levels in Ludhiana, Punjab. Carbon will ultimately be sequestered through innovative burial of biochar in underground vertical silos for durable, high\-integrity credits. Initially, biochar will be used by local farmers at nominal charge for soil amendment.

Commercial production commences in May 2026, with a targeted scale\-up to 10 MT of biochar per day by year\-end. We aim to forward\-sell carbon credits from June 2026 and achieve first issuances by September 2026\.

We are now enhancing our infrastructure with vertical refractory brick kilns equipped with real\-time sensing, syngas\-fed rotary dryers for paddy straw pre\-treatment, and a 12 MW syngas cogeneration unit to improve efficiency, consistency, and energy self\-sufficiency.

**Role Overview**

You will provide hands\-on execution support to the Senior Project Engineer, focusing on day\-to\-day site supervision, coordination, documentation, and real\-time data collection during construction and commissioning of the kilns, dryers, and cogeneration unit.

**Key Responsibilities** 

Supervise daily construction and installation activities at site (refractory brick laying for vertical kilns, rotary dryer assembly, syngas piping, and 12 MW cogeneration setup).

Coordinate with contractors and vendors for material receipt, installation, and quality checks.

Install, calibrate, and maintain real\-time sensing systems (temperature probes, gas analysers, flow meters, pressure sensors) across all equipment and feed live data to the central monitoring dashboard.

Support testing and commissioning of syngas\-fed rotary dryers and the cogeneration unit (including safety interlocks and performance trials).

Maintain detailed site records, daily progress reports, punch lists, as\-built drawings, and safety logs.

Assist in procurement follow\-up, inventory management of refractory materials, piping, and instrumentation.

Work closely with the Ludhiana Junior Sustainability Coordinator to ensure all sensing data feeds into the MRV system from day one.

Troubleshoot day\-to\-day site issues and escalate promptly to the Senior Project Engineer.

**Requirements** 

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.

2–5 years (or strong relevant internships) in industrial project execution, preferably involving kilns, dryers, thermal systems, or power generation.

Practical knowledge of sensors, instrumentation, and basic PLC/SCADA systems.

Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project/Excel, and site documentation.

Willingness to work long hours on\-site in a dusty, hot industrial environment.

Good Hindi/Punjabi communication skills for contractor coordination.

**Compensation** 

Base: ₹8 – 14 lakhs per annum

Site allowance \+ performance bonus.

**How to Apply:** 

Send your resume and a short note (max 150 words) explaining your interest in the role and willingness to be based in Ludhiana to hrm@carbonsecure.in . Mention “Project Engineer” in the subject line.

We are targeting a joining date of on or before 31 May 2026 and will prioritise candidates available to start immediately or with short notice.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

**Yantra 24x7\- Profimax Digiconnect Private Limited** is the flagship Smart Factory 4\.0 product of Profimax Digiconnect Private Limited, headquartered in Saibaba Colony,Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. We build Industrial IoT solutions that digitize CNC machine shops — giving manufacturers real\-time visibility into production, downtime, quality, and machine health.

Our platform — Yantra 24x7 — delivers measurable impact: 20–30% improvement in production efficiency, significant reduction in downtime, and payback in under 3 months. Trusted by 150\+ companies across Defence, Automotive, Aerospace, Medical Devices, Electronics, and Pumps \& Valves industries across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and beyond.

This is a ground\-floor opportunity to join a fast\-growing IoT company and become the face of Yantra 24x7 in your territory. You will be one of the first 5 Field Sales Engineers building a brand\-new sales motion — from identifying prospects in CNC machine shops to running product demonstrations, activating pilots, and converting them to paying customers.

This is not a passive inside\-sales role. ***hackajob**

**Description**
 You will collaborate closely with developers, product owners, designers, and other stakeholders to refine requirements, validate functionality, and introduce QA processes that uplift the team’s overall delivery quality. This position is ideal for someone who excels in dynamic environments, is comfortable wearing multiple hats, and can help build structure where formal QA processes are still maturing.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and user story creation.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to define project scope, goals, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate high‑level business needs into detailed Jira stories, tasks, and defects.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, and UI/UX teams to clarify requirements and resolve inconsistencies early in the sprint cycle.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet documented business needs and functional specifications.
* Design and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts to achieve comprehensive coverage of system functionality.
* Identify, document, and track defects using Jira, and collaborate with developers to validate fixes.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure product stability.
* Develop, execute, or maintain automation test scripts using JavaScript/TypeScript as needed.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in partnership with the engineering team.
* Analyze test results and produce clear, detailed reports for stakeholders.
* Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT), including support, training, and documentation for end users.
* Communicate progress, risks, blockers, and quality concerns effectively to project stakeholders.
* Continuously refine test processes, frameworks, and coverage to improve efficiency and overall product quality.
* Provide QA sign‑off for releases and maintain documentation for test results, processes, and standards.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in QA, Business Analysis, or a hybrid QA‑BA role.
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into clear, detailed Jira stories, tasks, and acceptance criteria.
* Hands‑on experience with software testing of scalable web applications, including functional, regression, and integration testing.

* Take lead and direction from the Senior People Partner to implement the people strategy for the business, translating high\-level direction into clear plans and actions for your scope.

* Provide accurate and well\-documented administrative and tactical support to People Partners (e.g., Workday changes, documentation, letters, audits, and employee records).


**AI\-first mindset and data**
* Connect structure, capability, performance, reward, and culture to design simple, scalable, AI\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes at enterprise level
* Use data (workforce, ticketing, ER trends, performance outcomes) to define problems, measure progress, and recommend trade\-offs; treat anecdotes as context, not direction.
* Use AI tools, such as Avi, Co\-pilot, and ChatGPT, to automate repeatable work. Additionally, use HR systems like Workday, ServiceNow, and HRIS/ATS to enhance employee experience.


**Storytelling, communication, and culture**
* Explain the “why”, trade\-offs, and expected outcomes of people decisions, linking them to our goals and employee experience


 You will report to Director, People Partner
   

  

 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* Experience:
+ Minimum 4\+ years of HR experience in a global organization
+ Master's degree in Human Resources
+ Experience supporting India\-based employee populations and partnering with global stakeholders strongly preferred.

* Technical skills:
+ Experience with HR systems (e.g., Workday, HRIS, ATS) and collaboration tools (Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack).
+ Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Avi) to drive efficiency, insight, and better employee/manager experiences.

* Professional skills and traits:
+ Demonstrated urgency, ownership, curiosity, humility, and passion for building a high\-performance, fair, and fun culture.
+ Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and maintain strong documentation and audit\-ready records.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 As a
 **network engineer,** 
 your primary responsibility will be to act as a proactive scout for the network, reviewing NMC tickets, alarming data, and existing automations to spot trends and identify new opportunities for innovation.
   

  

 You will perform deep\-dive data analysis into various systems to evaluate the performance of current workflows and determine their business impact. By "wading through" complex datapoints, you will synthesize information into a cohesive picture that enables the team to improve the network through strategic automation. Additionally, you will stay in sync with the broader US\-based team to ensure all automation efforts align with current operational needs.
   

  

 Your role will be within the Video Operations Network Management Center (NMC). The Video Operations NMC handles Tier I and Tier II functions for the FIOS Video footprint and is composed of multiple teams responsible for Broadcast Video/VIP (Video over Internet Protocol), VOD (Video on Demand) and Video Advertising Insertion. You will focus on implementing and maintaining automation to minimize and eliminate manual processes and enhance proactive solutions.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 You possess an "
 **automation mindset** 
 "—the innate ability to look at a manual process and visualize an automated solution. You are a detail\-oriented analyst who enjoys exploring various systems to find meaningful trends within large datasets. You thrive in a role that requires both independent investigation and collaborative synchronization with a global team.
   

  

**You’ll Need To Have**
* A Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of work experience.
* Foundational Python knowledge or significant experience in Network Automation.
* Proven experience with data analysis, specifically the ability to identify trends within complex datasets.
* Experience or the ability to quickly gain proficiency in ticketing and notification systems such as vRepair, Remedy, UTP, and Echo.
* Willingness to work a schedule that includes overlap with US day shift (specifically for weekly staff meetings and initial training).
* Solid troubleshooting and problem solving capabilities
* Ability to effectively communicate, collaborate and adapt


**Even Better If You Have**
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Familiarity with NMC operations, including ticket worklog entries and alarm attributes.
* The ability to interpret existing automation workflows to effectively answer end\-user questions.
* Established knowledge and understanding of telecommunications equipment/infrastructure and technologies such as Video, Data Communications and IP networks.
* Experience with large\-scale IT systems and infrastructure.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to stay in sync with a distributed team across different time zones.


 If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description: Network \& Security Engineer (5\+ Years Experience)**
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Network \& Security Engineer with 5\+ years of experience in enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in network operations, security administration, and incident response, and will be responsible for maintaining, securing, and optimizing our global enterprise network infrastructure.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on technical knowledge of firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, SIEM, endpoint security, and cloud networking, along with the ability to design, implement, and manage security controls aligned with industry best practices and compliance requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Network Operations \& Administration:
* Manage, monitor, and optimize enterprise LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, and routers/switches.
* Oversee daily network operations, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Implement and maintain network segmentation, redundancy, and high availability.
* Security Operations:
* Configure and manage firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, and threat intelligence tools.
* Monitor security logs, SIEM alerts, and network traffic for anomalies and potential threats.
* Lead incident response for security breaches, including root cause analysis and remediation.
* Access \& Identity Management:
* Administer user access controls, VPN authentication, and privileged account security.
* Collaborate with IAM/IDP solutions (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) for secure access.
* Cloud \& Hybrid Security:
* Secure cloud workloads in Azure/AWS with network and security best practices.
* Implement security controls across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
* Compliance \& Governance:
* Ensure security controls align with ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, GDPR, and enterprise policies.
* Maintain documentation of network diagrams, SOPs, and security standards.
* Collaboration:
* Work closely with IT, SOC, and application teams to integrate security into all operations.
* Assist in evaluating new technologies, tools, and processes for network and security enhancements.


**Qualifications**
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
   

  

 Experience: 5\+ years in enterprise network operations and security engineering roles.
   

  

**Certifications (Preferred)**
* Networking: CCNP, CCNA, CompTIA Network\+
* Security: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, or equivalent
* Cloud Security: Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Security Specialty


**Technical Skills**
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, QoS
* Security: Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco ASA), IDS/IPS, WAF, DLP
* SIEM \& Monitoring: Splunk, Falcon LogScale, QRadar, Sentinel, Darktrace
* Endpoint \& Identity: CrowdStrike, Okta, CyberArk, Netskope
* Cloud Security: AWS VPC, Azure NSGs, IAM policies, VPN gateways
* Scripting/Automation: PowerShell, Python, Ansible (preferred)
* Strong knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST CSF, and Zero Trust principles.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle incidents effectively.
* Collaborative mindset with cross\-functional teams.

 One of Sibros’ core products is to offer OTA (over\-the\-air) software updates to a fleet of vehicles. We believe all the new vehicles will have some form of connectivity to the cloud in a few years. We are building a deployment engine that powers millions of vehicles with millions of software updates. This is not an easy problem to solve, especially in the automotive industry: vehicles could go offline anytime, poor network connectivity is a norm, updates need to happen only in safe circumstances… the list could go on. As part of the team, you will be tackling one of the most challenging and critical problems in the OTA domain at planet scale, untangling various race conditions and scaling issues in a large distributed system.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design and implement highly scalable, reliable distributed systems to orchestrate firmware package and configuration deployments across millions of vehicles
* Build an end\-to\-end secure package distribution system leveraging the IEEE Uptane framework
* Collaborate closely with firmware engineers, frontend engineers, and product owners to deliver essential features such as deployment strategies and event\-driven notifications
* Define APIs as foundational building blocks that enable customers to automate their entire deployment workflows
* Understand vehicle\-to\-cloud communication patterns and develop efficient solutions to handle complex race conditions
* Engage directly with customers to understand real\-world pain points and iterate on product solutions


 What you should know
   

  

* 1 \- 4 years of working experience as a software engineer.
* Excellent in communication and collaboration across functional organizations.
* Excellent understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience in designing and implementing microservices in production\-grade.
* Willingness to wear multiple hats and adapt to a fast\-paced startup environment
* Proficient in writing at least one programming language (Java/ C\#/ Ruby/ Python/ Golang) in production\-grade.
* Experience in the public cloud and cloud\-native technologies. E.g., AWS, GCP, Azure.
* Experience in developing large\-scale deployment/workflow orchestration systems. (bonus)
* Good understanding of security, certificate, and encryption, and familiar with update frameworks like TUF or Uptane (bonus)


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive compensation package and benefits
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work\-life balance.


 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.
   

  

 This job description provides a comprehensive outline designed to attract individuals experienced in inside sales and looking to advance their career in a dynamic and growing industry. Adjustments can be made based on the specific needs of your team and changes in business strategies.

title: Software Engineer, Content Onboarding
description:
**About Us**
 Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.
   

  

 In\-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in\-office workdays.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a product\-focused engineering role on Notion’s Content Onboarding team. You’ll build import and migration experiences that help individuals and enterprises bring existing content into Notion with high fidelity and reliability.
   

  

 You’ll work across the stack, partnering closely with product, design, and go\-to\-market teams to ship features end\-to\-end. The work spans user\-facing flows, backend systems for large data movement, and the operational tooling needed to diagnose and improve reliability at scale.
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* You’ll contribute to Notion's user growth by building a delightful user experience that enables users to seamlessly migrate their content from existing productivity tools.
* You’ll contribute to the overall design, scale, reliability and robustness of the systems responsible for moving large amounts of customer data into and out of Notion.
* You would be enabling Notion move upmarket by working with a team of engineers and cross\-functional partners across product, design \& professional services to reliably migrate some of Notion’s biggest Enterprise customers from third\-party applications.


**Skills You'll Need To Bring**
* Proven track record of execution: You have 5\+ years of engineering experience, including several years building world\-class product experiences alongside a team of engineers.
* Building the team: You enjoy collaborating with both fellow engineers and cross\-functional partners. You are a lifelong learner and invest in both your own growth, but also the growth, learning, and development of your teammates.
* Thoughtful problem\-solving: You approach problems holistically, starting with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You think critically about the implications of what you're building and how it will impact real people's lives. You can navigate ambiguity flawlessly, decompose complex problems into clean solutions, while also balancing the business impact of what you’re building.
* Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.
* Empathetic communication: You clearly communicate complex ideas to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders—whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.  Bring your expertise to JPMorganChase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient. MRGR is a global team of modeling experts within the firm’s Risk Management and Compliance organization. The team is responsible for conducting independent model validation and model governance activities to help identify, measure, and mitigate Model Risk in the firm. Within MRGR, the Chief Operating Office (COO) supports model risk stakeholders in their review and governance activities, and drives certain governance activities itself, with responsibility for: product ownership, process engineering and software development for model risk technology and analytics; model risk reporting; administration of oversight committees; project management of the review and governance pipeline; coordination of regulatory/audit deliverables including capital stress testing exercises; and general business management. * Strong communication skills with the ability to interface with other functional areas in the firm on business requirements.
* Risk and control mindset: ability to think critically, assess user needs and create design solutions to meet user needs.

* Experience in working with large data sets.
* Exposure to LLM integration and deployment in real\-world applications.

Preferred candidates should have prior experience in web development or related fields, along with a strong interest in technology, user experience, and problem\-solving.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will excel in task\-based work, collaborating within project teams using tools such as Jira boards, and engaging effectively with colleagues across various disciplines, including backend teams, project management, and client\-facing roles. * Content Management: Skilled in utilizing Content Management Systems (CMS) to efficiently add, update, and manage web page content, ensuring accuracy and alignment with organizational standards.

* Page planning and website architecture
* Content hierarchy and organization
* Document and asset uploads

* Accountability and Ownership: Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership by taking full accountability for tasks and projects, ensuring timely and precise delivery while maintaining high\-quality standards.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities for improvement in web solutions, offering innovative suggestions to enhance functionality, optimize performance, and elevate the overall user experience.


**Competencies:**
* Teamwork \& Interpersonal Skills: Effectively managing teams while fostering a collaborative environment that promotes teamwork and strong communication skills.
* Strategic Thinking: Develops and implements strategic communication plans. Thinks ahead and plans for future needs.
* Problem\-Solving: Identifies and resolves issues efficiently. Uses critical thinking to find effective solutions.
* Stakeholder Management: Manages relationships with key stakeholders. Ensures effective communication and collaboration.
* Project Management: Oversees multiple projects simultaneously. Ensures projects are completed on time and within budget.


**About You**
**Qualifications:**
* Minimum Required Degree: Bachelor of Computer Application, Bachelor of Computer Engineering.
* Preferred Degree: BCA , BE
* Certificate(s)/Special Training: Web/Software Development


**Required Skills and Experience:**
* Strong Communication: Comfortable reporting progress to colleagues across various disciplines.
* Time Management: Capable of independently completing tasks within prescribed deadlines.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to comprehend complex content structures and apply them effectively.
* Quality Focus: Adherence to quality assurance standards and expectations.
* Task Execution: Proficient in interpreting instructions from Jira tickets and understanding project requirements.
* Problem\-Solving: Proactive in identifying and flagging issues to project team members as they arise.


**Additional Information**
**Compensation and benefits**
 On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits.
   

  

 Below are the
 **minimum core benefits** 
 you’ll get, depending on your job level, these benefits may improve:
   

  

* Medical Insurance and Parental Medical Insurance
* Accidental Insurance and Life Insurance
* Retirals \- Employee Gratuity, Future Service Gratuity benefit \- Group Term Life, Employee Provident Fund, National Pension Scheme
* Flexi Benefits Plan – Tax Savings Plans
* Annual Leave/ Maternity \& Paternity Leave/ Additional paid ML, Mental Health Day


**Other** 
**benefits include:**
* Employee Wellness Programs
* Training programs
* And more..


**We value inclusion and diversity**
 Inclusion and diversity (I\&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.
   

  

 Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.
   

  

 Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer\-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination.

The HR Executive will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR operations, supporting the implementation of HR systems, and maintaining strong internal communication with team members and survivors. This role requires an empathetic, detail\-oriented, and proactive individual who can balance administrative responsibilities with effective people management.

**Core Responsibilities HR Operations \& Systems**

* Support and carry out activities related to the ongoing implementation of new HR systems and digital tools.
* Manage and update employee records, attendance, contracts, and HR documentation.
* Prepare and coordinate documentation and processes related to all types of leave.
* Monitor the leave status of associates, track compensation during leaves of absence, and facilitate smooth return\-to\-work transitions.

**Employee Relations \& Survivor Support**

* Serve as the initial point of contact for HR\-related matters and provide guidance to employees.
* Co\-manage and serve as the main point of contact for all communication activities involving survivors.
* Maintain strong internal relationships with survivors and assist them with challenges, inquiries, and benefits as per organizational policies.
* Facilitate grievance redressal by listening to concerns and escalating matters appropriately.
* Ensure a trauma\-informed, supportive, and inclusive work environment.

**Policy, Compliance \& Coordination**

* Work closely with senior management to create, review, and revise HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with organizational HR policies and applicable statutory requirements such as PF, ESI, and labor laws.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for timely payroll inputs including attendance, overtime, and deductions.
* Draft HR letters, memos, notices, and internal communication as required.

**Recruitment, Onboarding \& Training**

* Support end\-to\-end recruitment activities including job postings, screening, interviews, and documentation.
* Facilitate onboarding, induction, and orientation programs for new employees and interns.
* Support training and development initiatives, including workshops and skill\-building programs for associates and survivors.

**Reporting \& Communication**

* Produce reports, graphs, charts, and required documents for the HR department.
* Prepare and compile data for monthly departmental reports for senior management and the board of directors.
* Collaborate effectively with internal teams and maintain open communication with senior leadership to ensure alignment on HR objectives.

**Employee Engagement \& Culture**

* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement activities, events, and welfare programs.
* Help build a positive, respectful, and growth\-oriented work culture aligned with the mission of survivor empowerment.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Management, Psychology, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of HR experience (NGO experience preferred).
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Empathy, patience, and the ability to work in a trauma\-informed environment.

**Remuneration**

* Salary range: **₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month**, based on experience.
* Additional benefits as per organizational policy.

title: Head - GEEC
description:
***Be the First to Apply***

Job Description


Head \- GEECThe Head of GEEC provides strategic leadership for global HR operations, delivering a seamless, compliant, and employee\-centric service model across the organization. The role oversees end\-to\-end employee lifecycle services, global payroll governance, statutory compliance, annual reporting, audit readiness, and HR data integrity across geographies. The incumbent drives service excellence through strong case management, self\-service and chatbot enablement, and continuous process improvement. By identifying automation and optimization opportunities and partnering with HR Technology for solution design and adoption (including Workday enhancements), the role advances digital transformation across HR operations.
**KEY STAKEHOLDERS: INTERNAL**

• HR Leadership Team, HR Business teams globally, HR COEs
• Functional Leaders
• Internal auditors
**KEY STAKEHOLDERS: EXTERNAL**

• Outsourcing Partners and Service Providers
• Industry Bodies and Compliance Authorities
• Statutory auditors
**REPORTING STRUCTURE:**

The position reports to the Chief Human Resource Officer, PPL. Team size \- \~20 employees, including 4 managers and associates across various workstreams within GEEC


**QUALIFICATION:**

• MBA in HR or equivalent postgraduate degree, Graduation in Science and Engg wil l be preferred
**EXPERIENCE:**

• 15\+ years of experience in HR, with 5\+ years in leadership roles.
• Exposure to end\-to\-end employee life cycle processes
• Experience in managing global HR operations, including hands\-on experience with any HRMS.
**CRITICAL QUALITIES:**

• Deep knowledge of end\-to\-end payroll, compliance, audits, HR data governance, and annual reporting.
• Strong focus on designing employee\-centric services, case management, and chatbot/self\-service solutions
• Advanced Excel, Eye for detail, reporting, and familiarity with HR systems to generate actionable insights.
• Process\-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, standardization, continuous improvement, and scalable operations.
• Proven ability to build high\-performing teams, develop talent, drive change management, and implement digital/automation solutions in partnership with HR Technology.
**Employee Service \& Experience Excellence**

• Review and refine the GEEC strategy and roadmap in alignment with enterprise HR priorities and evolving business needs.
• Champion a best\-in\-class employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).
• Design and implement scalable global service delivery models that are employee\-centric, responsive, and easy to navigate.
• Establish and monitor service metrics (SLAs, TAT, CSAT, NPS) to continuously enhance service quality.
• Strengthen self\-service capabilities, knowledge management frameworks, and communication channels to improve accessibility and transparency.
**HR Data Governance \& Reporting**

• Establish and maintain strong HR data governance standards, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality.
• Ensure data readiness for internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance reviews.
• Oversee preparation and validation of annual HR reporting, statutory workforce disclosures, and compliance submissions.
• Strengthen data controls, documentation, and SOPs to support audit trails and reporting transparency.
• Drive data quality improvement initiatives in partnership with HRBPs and HR Technology teams.
• Identify and mitigate operational, compliance, and data privacy risks across HR processes, ensuring adherence to internal policies and regulatory frameworks.
**Process Excellence and Digital enablement:**

• Identify process improvement and automation opportunities across HR operations.
• Partner with HR Leadership to continuously evolve the HR operating model, optimizing centralization, automation, and service effectiveness
• Define business requirements and partner with the HR Technology team to design appropriate system solutions (including HRMS optimization).
• Collaborate closely with HR Tech on implementation, testing, change management, and adoption of new tools and enhancements.
• Drive the effective deployment of case management platforms and AI\-enabled solutions (e.g., HR chatbots) to enhance self\-service and reduce manual effort.
• Establish governance mechanisms and operating rhythms to ensure consistent and efficient service delivery across geographies and businesses.
**Global Payroll Leadership \& Compliance**

• Own end\-to\-end payroll governance (Currently India), ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing.
• Lead the strategic consolidation of payroll operations across geographies, transitioning country\-managed payroll processes into a centralized, standardized, and well\-governed global payroll model.
• Ensure compliance with local statutory regulations, tax laws, labor laws, and global corporate policies including meeting with statutory bodies wherever required.
• Oversee payroll reconciliations, variance analysis, payroll funding, provisioning, statutory disclosures and financial controls in partnership with Finance.
• Ensure timely statutory filings, year\-end payroll activities, and annual reporting requirements.
• Manage payroll audits (internal and external), respond to auditor queries, and ensure timely remediation of findings.
**Team Leadership \& Development**

• Build and lead a high\-performing, service\-oriented GEEC team.
• Develop internal talent pipelines and strengthen succession planning.
• Enhance team capabilities through cross\-skilling, upskilling, and leadership development.
• Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, compliance discipline, and continuous improvement.
**Vendor \& Partner Governance**

• Manage relationships with external payroll, HR services vendors, ensuring service quality, cost efficiency, and contractual compliance.
• Establish performance metrics and governance mechanisms to monitor vendor delivery and drive continuous improvement.

title: Sr. D&T Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
:

India is among the top ten priority markets for General Mills, and hosts our Global Shared Services Centre. This is the Global Shared Services arm of General Mills Inc., which supports its operations worldwide. With over 1,300 employees in Mumbai, the center has capabilities in the areas of Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Digital and Technology, Sales Capabilities, Consumer Insights, ITQ (R\&D \& Quality), and Enterprise Business Services. Position Title  

Sr D\&T Analyst, Supply Chain

Digital \& Technology  

Location  

Mumbai

11 am to 8 pm
