D\&T Manager E2E Supply chain (End to End)  

Remote/Hybrid/in\-Office  

Hybrid  

**ABOUT GENERAL MILLS**

 **We make food the world loves: 100 brands. In 100 countries. Across six continents.** With iconic brands like Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Häagen\-Dazs, we’ve been serving up food the world loves for 155 years (and counting). Each of our brands has a unique story to tell.


How we make our food is as important as the food we make. Our values are baked into our legacy and continue to accelerate


us into the future as an innovative force for good. General Mills was founded in 1866 when Cadwallader Washburn boldly bought the largest flour mill west of the Mississippi. That pioneering spirit lives on today through our leadership team who upholds a vision of relentless innovation while being a force for good. For more details check out http://www.generalmills.com

  

General Mills India Center (GIC) is our global capability center in Mumbai that works as an extension of our global organization delivering business value, service excellence and growth, while standing for good for our planet and people.


With our team of 1800\+ professionals, we deliver superior value across the areas of Supply chain (SC) , Digital \& Technology (D\&T) Innovation, Technology \& Quality (ITQ), Consumer and Market Intelligence (CMI), Sales Strategy \& Intelligence (SSI) , Global Shared Services (GSS) , Finance Shared Services (FSS) and Human Resources Shared Services (HRSS).For more details check out https://www.generalmills.co.in


We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

 **Function Overview**

  

The Digital and Technology team at General Mills stands as the largest and foremost unit, dedicated to exploring the latest trends and innovations in technology while leading the adoption of cutting\-edge technologies across the organization. Collaborating closely with global business teams, the focus is on understanding business models and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for increased efficiency and disruption. The team's expertise spans a wide range of areas, including AI/ML, Data Science, IoT, NLP, Cloud, Infrastructure, RPA and Automation, Digital Transformation, Cyber Security, Blockchain, SAP S4 HANA and Enterprise Architecture. The MillsWorks initiative embodies an agile@scale delivery model, where business and technology teams operate cohesively in pods with a unified mission to deliver value for the company. Employees working on significant technology projects are recognized as Digital Transformation change agents.

  



The team places a strong emphasis on service partnerships and employee engagement with a commitment to advancing equity and supporting communities. In fostering an inclusive culture, the team values individuals passionate about learning and growing with technology, exemplified by the "Work with Heart" philosophy, emphasizing results over facetime. Those intrigued by the prospect of contributing to the digital transformation journey of a Fortune 500 company are encouraged to explore more details about the function through the following Link

 **Purpose of the role**

  

This is an exciting time to be part of General Mills’ Solutions Delivery organization!

  

We are accelerating the Digital Transformation of Supply Chain business processes to drive smarter, faster, and value\-focused decisions. To support this mission, we are looking for a Sr D\&T Analyst with a passion for process optimization, data enablement, and metric automation to join our D\&T Supply Chain Business Process Management (BPM) Solutions Delivery team.

  

The BPM D\&T team works in close partnership with business stakeholders to build scalable data foundations, deliver automated and trusted metrics, and enable decision support capabilities across key process areas like LCF (Logistics, Customer \& Order Fulfillment) and MaKE (Manufacturing \& E2E Enablement). We leverage platforms like GCP, Alation, Azure DevOps, Palantir Foundry and custom\-built BPM portals (.net Based) to operationalize insights and create visibility into the health of our supply chain processes.

  

Key focus areas for this role include:


Providing technical consultation on the tools, platforms, and cloud\-based data pipelines that enable BPM metric automation and governance. Acting as a champion and enabler for data\-driven process decisions through BPM Portals, metric nodes, and stakeholder training. Leading metric development, from user story creation to deployment and training, while ensuring alignment to GMI’s Digital Supply Chain vision.

 **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Drive BPM initiatives across and perform Run and Improve tasks in the role of a data analyst in key supply chain processes (LCF/MaKE) by enabling automated, accurate, and scalable performance metrics
* Serve as the technical SME for BPM digital tools, portals, and metric repositories; provide insights and recommendations to drive decision\-making across Supply Chain operations
* Define and manage user stories in Azure DevOps (ADO); translate business requirements into technical solutions aligned with GMI’s Digital Supply Chain goals
* Lead development and implementation of metric nodes, process documents, and user training in the BPM Portal for end\-to\-end metric visibility as a D\&T analyst
* Drive projects along Supply Chain business processes; Work with SAP teams, ML engineers in the Product Platform model. Lead the team with deep knowledge into Planning and Deployment Supply chain areas
* Partner with cross\-functional PODs to proactively identify metric gaps, process constraints, and opportunities for automation and simplification
* Collaborate with data governance teams to align on metric definitions, data sources, and lineage documentation using tools like Alation and Collibra
* Act as the primary liaison between BPM business stakeholders and D\&T architects to ensure alignment on data models
* Participate in Agile PODs and drive delivery cadence with cross\-functional teams.
 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Education: Full\-time Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, with 7\+ years in supply chain systems with strong data foundation.
* Strong hands\-on experience in data engineering preferably within large\-scale CPG/FMCG environments.
* Working knowledge of GCP cloud and Proficiency in SQL, Python
* Experience using BPM portals, Azure DevOps, or similar tools to manage user stories, backlog, and metric delivery life cycle.
* Solid understanding of casefill, demand forecast accuracy, and other core supply chain metrics, with ability to translate them into automated KPIs.
* Familiarity with data governance practices, and tools such as Alation, Collibra, or equivalent for metric lineage and documentation.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally with business users, technical architects, and analytics teams to co\-develop solutions and drive adoption.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and process\-thinking skills, with ability to operate in Agile, POD\-based delivery environments.
* Highly collaborative, self\-directed, and committed to driving clarity in complex, data\-driven transformation initiatives.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Proven experience supporting Business Process Management (BPM) or Continuous Improvement functions through data and reporting.
* Experience in or Knowledge of Palantir Foundry capabilities
	+ Data Integration and Harmonization – Database connectivity, APIs, Cloud Storage, Data Cleansing
	+ Advanced Analytics and Visualization\- perform complex queries, build data models, and derive actionable insights through interactive dashboards, low\-code tools, and visualization components.
	+ Operational Decision making – tools/reports/dashboard for complex operational decision making
* Strong working knowledge of SQL, BigQuery, and Python for data wrangling, cleaning, and automation of recurring metrics.
* Strong working knowledge metric automation, and BPM enablemen
* Hands\-on experience creating trusted, automated dashboards using tools like Tableau, Google Data Studio, Power BI, or Looker.
* Familiarity with Alation, Collibra, or other data cataloging/governance tools to ensure lineage, definition, and trust in reported metrics.
* Ability to translate complex supply chain processes (e.g., LCF, MaKE) into structured, repeatable metric frameworks.
* Understanding of key supply chain performance metrics: forecast accuracy, casefill, inventory health, OTIF, etc.
* Experience working in Agile PODs, including managing sprint deliverables and backlog in Azure DevOps or JIRA.
* Exposure to cloud data ecosystems like Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and working with data in production\-level pipelines.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate data\-driven insights and support change enablement across diverse business teams.
* Curiosity\-driven and self\-starter mindset with the ability to operate independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

  


Company Overview:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one other and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding**

* Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and hiring teams.
* Manage job postings across external job boards and internal platforms.
* Maintain and update the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and track candidate progress.
* Screen resumes for basic qualifications and route candidates appropriately.
* Communicate interview details, status updates, and document requirements to candidates.
* Manage offer approval workflows and prepare offer letters.
* Initiate and monitor background checks, reference checks, and medical checks.
* Collect, verify, and file new hire documents in Workday for localized and non‑localized hires.
* Share new hire details with CRES and IT for workspace, systems access, and equipment setup.
* Send welcome emails and support onboarding coordination.
* Maintain the New Hire Tracker and ensure accurate completion of Workday onboarding tasks.
* Support IRG activities and assist with recruitment events or career fairs as needed.

**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com

title: Recruiter
description:
**Description**  

**Corporate Recruiter**  

The Recruiter drives the identification and attraction of talent through strategic marketing, diversity outreach, passive recruiting, and social media. Previous Call Center experience a PLUS

**In this role you will:*** Lead the talent acquisition process from requisition approval through new hire on\-boarding.
* Establish and maintain relationships with key decision\-makers within the departments to ensure full understanding of business unit goals, initiatives, and challenges, in order, to align the talent acquisition strategy to the needs of the business.
* Use passive and direct sourcing techniques and seeks new methods and innovative solutions to identify and attract prospective candidates and build pipeline.
* Leverage in\-house recruitment efforts and online recruiting resources to examine and hire ideal candidates.
* Manage the selection, presentation, closing, negotiation, offer, and administrative components for new hires.
* Maintain well\-ordered and accurate documentation on all candidates.
* Use social and professional networking sites to identify and source candidates.
* Function as the primary point of contact and coordinate appropriately with all parties involved in the process.
* Manage all required pre\-screenings and ensure assessment tools are utilized and consistent.
* Schedules and coordinate all hiring manager interviews.

**We are looking for someone who has:*** Bachelor’s in Human Resources or other related fields.
* 2\+ years of full life cycle/high volume recruiting experience.
* Demonstrated business acumen in understanding hiring managers needs and applying appropriate recommendations.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written.
* Excellent negotiation skills and effective organizational skills.
* The ability to thrive in a fast\-paced results\-oriented environment

**About ResultsCX:**  

ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**1 to 3 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** • Data entry in HR1S and managing service request via Oracle Helpdesk. • Update HR1S systems, which include, but not limited to internal and client\-based applications with HR transactions • Double\-check all work before submission to ensure accuracy • Extract, Analyse and Deliver the output report to ensure data has been processed accurately • Must have clear understanding of the existing matrices in the process, how they are measured. e.g. SLA, KPI • Complete tasks within the assigned time frame (SLA) to ensure timely delivery • Communicate with the requestor via Helpdesk to receive accurate information to proceed with the service request • Reviews all input to ensure data is compliant with standard operation procedure practices • Escalate issues and seek advice when faced with complex issues/problems • Stick to established processes and guidelines like Localisation documents to ensure consistent, accurate results, leverage tools, checklists, or templates provided to ensure work is done correctly • Propose process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and controls contributing We Innovate Initiatives • Effective communication and teamwork abilities • Attention to detail and the ability to manage BAU • Act on feedback provided by supervisors or SMEs to improve your accuracy and efficiency moving forward • Complete Accenture and Client’s mandatory training but not limited to TQ, DQ, Ethics and Compliance, CTD and ensuring full adherence to developmental trainings • Ensuring accurate complete and timely reporting of data in Accenture and client tools as per requirements (ADRT, GPH, SQF, DMS, T\&E, etc.) • Collaborate with client Local People Partner (HRBP) for process clarification, updates or assistance • Proactively identify and mitigate process risks using prior HR experience. Escalate unmitigated risks to supervisors • Practice Root Cause Analysis on issues and recommend corrective and preventive actions to mitigate future occurrences. • Participate in Knowledge Transfer sessions to gain a solid understanding of processes and client\-specific initiatives, Business Transformation and developing expertise in key areas like Subject Matter Expert (SME)  

**What are we looking for?** Hand\-on Knowledge of HRMS (SAP, Workday, Oracle) is required •• 1\-3 years of experience in Human Resource Operations (HRO) with prior knowledge of HR processing • Hands on experience of managing work through workflow tool like Oracle • Should be proficient with MS Office Tools like Excel, Word, Outlook and Webmail • Must have excellent command over verbal and written English • Expertise in ensuring data privacy, security, and compliance with legal and client\-specific data protection standards • Maintain the highest level of confidentiality by strictly adhering to client data protection policies and legal standards, ensuring all sensitive information is securely handled. • Prioritizing tasks and managing time efficiently to handle multiple data\-related responsibilities. • Continuously seeking ways to enhance data management processes for greater efficiency and effectiveness. • Adjusting to new tools, technologies, and processes in a dynamic work environment. • Showcase technical proficiency by staying updated with the latest data management technologies and applying them to improve data workflows
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines • Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor • You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments • The decisions that you make would impact your own work • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

**What would you do?** Meaningful Conversation: Being a People Lead, people conversations are essential for building trust, fostering development, and maintaining a positive team environment: • Roll\-On and Roll\-Off Coordinator: As the Roll\-On and Roll\-Off Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the seamless integration of new joiners (Roll\-On) and the smooth and secure transition for leavers (Roll\-Off) within the organization. This role ensures that both processes are carried out efficiently and in accordance with guidelines. • Performance Review: Performance review is essential for assessing and fostering team growth with proper communication which helps drive better meaning conversation and connectedness with the team members eam Engagement: Organize team outings to provide a break from the routine. Whether it s a fun activity or a team\-building exercise, outings allow team members to recharge and return to work with renewed energy and focus. Encourage a healthy work\-life balance by incorporating regular outings or social activities. These events promote mental well\-being, stress relief, and better work\-life integration • Retention and Alerts: Retention alerts and conversations are critical for identifying and addressing potential issues that could lead to team member turnover Work Allocation: Work allocation refers to distributing tasks or responsibilities fairly among team members, ensuring that work is completed on time and aligns with agreed SLAs. You will oversee workload distribution, ensure tasks are assigned effectively, and manage the overall performance of the team • Capacity Planning: Capacity planning ensures that the team has enough resources (time, skills, manpower) to meet the workload. You will need to estimate the team’s overall capacity and plan tasks to ensure they are achievable without overwhelming anyone

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of increasingly complex problems • Your day to day interactions are with peers within Accenture • You are likely to have some interaction with clients and/or Accenture management • You will be given minimal instruction on daily work/tasks and a moderate level of instruction on new assignments • Decisions that are made by you impact your own work and may impact the work of others • In this role you would be an individual contributor and/or oversee a small work effort and/or team • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

title: Internal Audit-Hyderabad-Analyst-Business Audit
description:
Internal Audit – Bengaluru – Analyst\- Enterprise Audit  



The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial centers around the world. We commit people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Our people are our greatest asset – we say it often and with good reason. It is only with the determination and dedication of our people that we can serve our clients, generate long\-term value for our shareholders and contribute to the broader public. We take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative workspaces and ergonomic services to well\-being and resilience offerings, we offer our people the flexibility and support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office

  

INTERNAL AUDIT  

In Internal Audit, we ensure that Goldman Sachs maintains effective controls by assessing the reliability of financial reports, monitoring the firm’s compliance with laws and regulations, and advising management on developing smart control solutions. Our group has unique insight on the financial industry and its products and operations. We’re looking for detail\-oriented team players who have an interest in financial markets and want to gain insight into the firm’s operations and control processes.  



WHAT WE LOOK FOR  

Goldman Sachs Internal Auditors demonstrate strong risk and control mindsets, analytical, exercise professional skepticism and are able to challenge and discuss effectively with management on risks and control measures. We look for individuals who enjoy learning about audit, businesses and functions, have innovative and creative mindsets to adopt analytical techniques to enhance audit techniques, building relationships and are able to evolve and thrive in teamwork and in a fast\-paced global environment.  



YOUR IMPACT  

As the third line of defense, Internal Audit’s mission is to independently assess the firm’s internal control structure, including the firm’s governance processes and controls, and risk management and capital and anti\-financial crime frameworks, raise awareness of control risk and monitor the implementation of management’s control measures. In doing so, internal Audit:  

* Communicates and reports on the effectiveness of the firm’s governance, risk management and controls that mitigate current and evolving risk
* Raise awareness of control risk
* Assesses the firm’s control culture and conduct risks
* Monitors management’s implementation of control measures

  

Goldman Sachs Internal Audit comprises individuals from diverse backgrounds including chartered accountants, developers, risk management professionals, cybersecurity professionals, and data scientists. We are organized into global teams comprising business and technology auditors to cover all the firm’s businesses and functions, including securities, investment banking, consumer and investment management, risk management, finance, cyber\-security and technology risk, and engineering.  

This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. It is not intended to be a complete list of assigned duties but to describe a position level. The  

role shall be performed within a professional office environment. Goldman Sachs has health and safety polices that are available for all workers upon request. There are no specific health risks associate with the  

role.  



RESPONSIBILITIES  

As an Sr Analyst/Associate, you will be responsible for execution of audit deliverables through effective time management, in accordance with the internal audit methodology of the department. You will assist the project manager in planning the scope of the audit, conduct walkthroughs and discussions with various teams to execute the audit scope and discuss results of the audit with the firms local and global management. You will play a vital role in execution of the audit scope, through succinct documentation and active engagement with various stakeholders focusing on analyzing the risks involved, assessing the design and operating effectiveness of the key controls implemented to mitigate the risk, in accordance with the internal audit methodology of the department. In addition, you will also monitor and follow up with management on the resolution of the open audit findings and maintain stakeholder relationship to monitor risk in their space. Job responsibilities also include assisting in the department’s continuous monitoring effort to cover operations incidents, market and regulatory events, business and technology updates. You are strongly encouraged to participate in department\-wide initiatives aimed at continually improving IA's processes and supporting infrastructure.  



Basic Qualifications  

* Chartered Accountant /Certified Financial Analyst /Masters in Business Administration specialized in Finance / Masters or equivalent University degrees in Accounting / Finance.
* CA fresher or 1 years of experience in risk\-based operations / process audits preferably focusing on areas such as human resources, accounts payable, procurement, third party risk management, and/or payment functions.
* Experience in executing audit engagements, with good judgement of risks and controls
* Strong technical skills required for the role with attention to detail, strong analytical skills and ability to translate the assimilated knowledge through effective documentation
* Experience in working in a team environment and adaptable to differential ways of working
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal skills, as the job requires frequent interaction with cross functional teams and stakeholders across the hierarchy within management
* Highly motivated with the ability to multi\-task and remain organized in a fast\-paced environment


Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
* Relevant certification or industry accreditation
* Capable of developing or implementing efficiency improvement or automated solutions that assist audit work
**We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits**
Healthcare \& Medical Insurance
We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.


Holiday \& Vacation Policies
We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.


Financial Wellness \& Retirement
We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.


Health Services
We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices.


Fitness
To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on\-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre\-approved amount).


Child Care \& Family Care
We offer on\-site child care centers that provide full\-time and emergency back\-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available.

description:
**Job Description: Data Analyst Internship (2 Months)**

**Position**: Data Analyst Intern

**Experience Level**: Freshers/Students

**Company:** CareerNaksha

**About us:'**

CareerNaksha' is an ed\-tech start\-up based company at Vadodara. Here we work as a source of support when candidates experience difficulty finding jobs and choosing the right career path and also guide the clients through counseling for the completion of aptitude ,personality, and adjacent tests. Here we are looking for the aspirantor Social Media Intern who help us build and grow our online presence

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a motivated and skilled **Data Analyst Intern** who can assist with data scraping, analysis, visualization, and research. You will have the opportunity to work on real\-world data, contribute to building data tools, and create insightful dashboards using Power BI. This internship is ideal for someone who is eager to learn and gain hands\-on experience in data analysis and business intelligence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Data Collection \& Scraping**:
* Build Python scripts to scrape data from websites and social media platforms.
* Gather data through APIs from social media sites (e.g., Twitter, Instagram) for analysis.
* **Data Cleaning \& Analysis**:
* Clean and process raw data to ensure accuracy and usability.
* Analyze datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
* Work with Python and tools like Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for data analysis and visualization.
* **Power BI Dashboard Creation**:
* Create dynamic dashboards in Power BI to visualize data.
* Design visual reports to communicate key insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
* **Tool Development**:
* Assist in developing automated scraping tools to collect data on an ongoing basis.
* Optimize and maintain data scraping tools for accuracy and efficiency.
* **Research**:
* Conduct research on scraping techniques, APIs, and data collection methods.
* Stay updated on the latest trends and tools for data analysis and business intelligence.

**Requirements:**

* **Education**: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* **Technical Skills**:
* Proficiency in **Python** for data scraping, data analysis, and automation.
* Basic understanding of **web scraping libraries** (e.g., BeautifulSoup, Scrapy).
* Familiarity with **Power BI** or any other data visualization tools.
* Knowledge of APIs for social media platforms (Twitter, Instagram, etc.) is a plus.
* **Analytical Skills**:
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset.
* Ability to work with large datasets and identify trends, insights, and opportunities.
* **Research Skills**:
* Ability to research and implement various scraping and data collection techniques.
* **Communication Skills**:
* Ability to present data insights clearly and effectively.

**What You’ll Learn:**

* Hands\-on experience in data scraping, analysis, and visualization.
* Building and optimizing data tools and automated scraping systems.
* Working with real business challenges to derive meaningful insights from data.
* Creating interactive dashboards that influence decision\-making in a business context.
* Exposure to real\-world projects in a dynamic work environment.

This internship is perfect for someone looking to gain practical experience in data analysis, Python scripting, and Power BI dashboard creation. You'll be working on tasks that challenge both your technical and analytical skills while getting valuable industry exposure.

**Task Assignment for Data Analyst Internship**

As part of the application process, you are required to complete the following assignment to demonstrate your skills in data scraping, analysis, and visualization.

**Task: Data Scraping, Analysis, and VisualizationScenario:**

You are tasked with analyzing product reviews and social media engagement for a specific product category (e.g., mobile phones or laptops) across e\-commerce websites and social media platforms. The goal is to gather insights into customer sentiment, pricing trends, and engagement metrics to inform business decisions.

**Assignment Instructions:**

* **Data Scraping**:
* **Website Scraping**:
* Write a Python script to scrape product reviews and ratings from a popular e\-commerce website (such as Amazon or Flipkart). Extract the following fields:
* Product name
* Product price
* Average rating
* Number of reviews
* Review text (optional: scrape a few recent reviews)
* Store the data in a CSV file.
* **Social Media Data**:
* Use any social media platform's API (e.g., Twitter API, Instagram Graph API) to extract engagement metrics for a specific product or brand. Extract:
* Post content
* Likes, comments, shares (or retweets)
* Hashtags used
* Store the data in a structured format (CSV or JSON).
* **Data Cleaning and Analysis**:
* Clean the datasets to ensure there are no missing or incorrect values.
* Analyze the data to identify key trends, such as:
* Price trends and how they relate to customer reviews and ratings.
* The correlation between social media engagement (likes, shares) and customer sentiment in reviews.
* Insights on popular hashtags and their impact on engagement.
* **Visualization (Power BI)**:
* Import the cleaned dataset into Power BI.
* Create a dashboard that includes the following:
* A visual representation of product ratings and reviews across price ranges.
* A chart showing social media engagement metrics (e.g., likes, shares) over time.
* A correlation chart between social media posts and customer sentiment based on reviews.
* **Deliverables**:
* Submit your Python scripts for scraping both website and social media data.
* Provide the cleaned dataset (in CSV/Excel format).
* Share your Power BI dashboard (exported as a PDF or shareable Power BI link).
* Include a short document (1 page) summarizing your approach, key findings, and recommendations based on the analysis.

**Evaluation Criteria:**

* **Python Skills**: Efficiency and functionality of scraping scripts (website and social media).
* **Data Cleaning**: Quality of data cleaning and preparation for analysis.
* **Analysis \& Insights**: Depth and relevance of insights drawn from the data.
* **Power BI Dashboard**: Clarity, usability, and effectiveness of visualizations.
* **Presentation**: Clear communication of your approach, findings, and recommendation

**"We are looking for the ones who refuse to be average."**

**Role: Associate Consultant**

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On\-site)

**Timing:** 7:30 PM – 4:30 AM (Indian Time) \[i.e. 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern Time]

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time (Freshers Needed. Experienced Candidates, Welcome)

**Compensation:** "Write Your Own Paycheck" Model.

**Fixed Base:** ₹17,200 \- ₹21,200 (Based on interview performance).

**Performance Incentives:** Uncapped.

**The Reality:** A top performer who hits their targets can easily earn ₹**50,000 incentive per month**.

We care about your results. If you perform, **YOU MAKE MONEY**. Period.

Most freshers are looking for a "safe" job. This is not that job. Safe is boring. Safe doesn't build empires.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an Associate Career Consultant. **Basically, we are looking for a Future Leader. Someone who is smart, dangerously ambitious,** and believes they can figure out the answer to*any* question on Earth. You will be personally trained by the Founders. You will not be served coffee; you will be taught how to think, sell, and strategize like a CEO.

**What You Will Actually Do:**

You are not a support agent. You are a Consultant.

* **Consultative Selling –** You will speak with potential clients, diagnose their career problems, and prescribe the 3Engineers solution. You will learn the art of high\-ticket persuasion.
* **Management Consulting –** You will analyze complex client profiles and build "Go\-to\-Market" strategies. You will tell a Project Manager why his resume is failing and exactly how to fix it.
* **Client Portfolio Management –** You will own the relationship. You will manage the anxieties, expectations, and triumphs of high\-level professionals.
* **Meta\-Learning –** By managing the careers of others, you will hack your own. You will learn exactly what a "Product Manager" does at Google, or what a "Solutions Architect" does at AWS, without ever having to write code. You will become a walking encyclopedia of the corporate world.

**Company Overview:**

We are **3Engineers Consultancy**, an Executive Career Management Firm. We don't just "advise" or "fix resumes"; we engineer careers. We believe in **unlocking potential, fostering growth, and guiding individuals towards career success.** We specialize in career consulting, professional branding, and strategic networking solutions, helping individuals take confident steps toward their career aspirations.

As part of our expanding team, we are looking for individuals who are **curious, adaptable, and strong communicators**, those who enjoy problem\-solving, critical thinking, and working in a **dynamic, fast\-paced environment**. We don’t expect you to know everything from day one; **we provide training** to help you succeed in this role.

You will be working directly with the **Founders**, learning the art of **American business strategy** while disrupting the **hiring ecosystem**.

**"Don't just find a job. Help us fix the system."**

**Team Culture:**

We’ve created a **fun, safe space** for you to **brainstorm**, ask questions, and find solutions. Everyone is encouraged to share their **ideas for positive change**, no matter what role or level.

**We support and lift one another** and help each other become better. Recognition, integrity, and the desire to help others are our winning combination.

**Who We’re Looking For?**

We value **skills over titles and potential over experience.** If you identify with the following traits, we encourage you to apply:

**The Non\-Negotiables:**

* **Elite Communication –** You will be talking to US\-based clients. You cannot just be "fluent"; you must be articulate, persuasive, and confident.
* **The "Figure\-It\-Out" Gene –** If we ask you a question you don't know, your answer isn't "I don't know." It is *"Give me 5 minutes, and I'll find out."*
* **Unsettling Ambition –** You are the person who isn't satisfied with "good enough." You want to be at the top of the food chain.
* **Emotional Intelligence –** You can handle a stressed\-out client with grace and turn their panic into confidence.
* **Researcher –** Whether it’s understanding industry trends, job markets, or professional growth strategies, you know how to find and present valuable insights.
* **Professionalism –** Handling sensitive information with discretion and ethical responsibility is important to you.

**The "Latent Abilities":**

* **Executive Presence –** You command respect in a room, even if you are the youngest person there.
* **First\-Principles Thinking –** You look at a broken process and ask, *"Why do we do it this way?"* instead of just following orders.
* **Problem\-solver –** You are capable of analyzing situations, identifying key points, and offering well\-thought\-out suggestions.
* **Adaptive mindset –** You are eager to learn, open to feedback, and capable of adjusting to evolving work dynamics.
* **Organized and Detail\-oriented –** Managing multiple tasks, structuring information clearly, and keeping track of follow\-ups come naturally to you.
* **People Person –** Whether it’s guiding, assisting, or simply interacting, you have the ability to listen, understand, and engage professionally.

**You are based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and are comfortable working a US shift (7:30 PM – 4:30 AM IST).**

*Prior experience in career consulting, professional writing, HR, or communications is a plus but NOT required. If you have the skills and willingness to learn, we’ll train you!*

**Why Join 3Engineers?**

✅ **The "Founder's Shadow" –** You will work directly with the Founders. You will see how a US Corporation is built, scaled, and managed from the inside. This is a real\-world MBA.

✅ **Master Class in Business –** You will learn Sales, Strategy, Operations, and Psychology. These are skills that will make you employable forever.

✅ **Client Management –** You aren't just processing data; you are the "Captain" of the client's search. You will learn how to manage expectations, handle competing priorities, and communicate with high\-level professionals.

✅ **Exposure to Global Career Strategies –** Gain insights into industry hiring practices, career development frameworks, and professional branding techniques.

✅ **Zero Ceiling –** We are a high\-growth startup. If you prove yourself, you won't just be an employee; you will be a leader.

✅ **Training \& Development –** We provide structured training to help you refine your skills and excel in this role.

✅ **US Exposure –** You are playing in the Major Leagues. You will interact with the US Clients every single day.

***(Freshers are highly encouraged to apply. If you are smart, we will teach you the rest.)***

We’re excited to meet individuals who are passionate, motivated, and ready to grow with us!

* Support in root cause analysis (RCA) for non\-conformities.

**Safety \& Compliance**


* Follow all safety protocols, PPE requirements, and workplace standards.
* Participate in safety audits and hazard identification activities.
* Ensure safe work practices on the shop floor.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Coordinate with Maintenance for breakdown follow\-up and preventive maintenance schedules.

This is a hands\-on role involving zinc recovery and electrowinning operations at our Ranipet facility. You will be trained in both laboratory analysis and plant operations, working directly on real industrial processes. Extensive on\-the\-job training will be provided from day one.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

1\. Education: Diploma / B.Sc / B.Tech in any of the following:  
2\. Chemical Engineering / Metallurgy / Chemistry  
3\. Experience: Fresher / 0–1 year.  
4\. Prior internship in a chemical or process industry is a plus.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Lab Work**

* Chemical analysis (Zn %, impurities, pH)
* Sample preparation and testing
* Maintain lab records and reports

**Process / Plant Work**

* Assist in leaching, purification, and electrowinning
* Monitor current/voltage, temperature, and pH
* Support daily plant operations

**Data \& Process Improvement**

* Record and track process data consistently
* Assist in improving recovery efficiency, product purity, and energy usage

**WORK STRUCTURE**

* 3\-shift rotational operation
* Role involves both lab work and shop\-floor / plant operations

**TRAINING \& COMMITMENT**

* Extensive hands\-on training provided across lab and plant functions
* Minimum 18\-month lock\-in period required due to the depth of specialized training invested

**SKILLS REQUIRED**

* Basic understanding of chemical / process engineering concepts
* Willingness to work in an industrial environment (shift\-based, hands\-on)
* Strong observation, documentation, and reporting skills
* Practical, learning\-oriented mindset with attention to detail

**WHAT YOU WILL LEARN**

* Zinc recycling process: ash to refined metal
* Electrowinning technology and cell operations
* Industrial process monitoring and control
* Scaling up from lab\-scale experiments to full plant operations

**GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES\-** Process Engineer , Plant Operations Engineer and R\&D / Scale\-up Roles

description:

We are looking for a qualified professional—preferably a **Biomedical Engineer**—to work in our **Footcare (Podiatry) Department**. * Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer
description:
A Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer is responsible for ensuring that software products and systems meet the specified quality standards before they are released to customers.

Job Description

Test Planning: Planning and creating test strategies and plans that will ensure that software products are thoroughly tested and any defects are identified and resolved before release.

Test Execution: Executing test plans and test cases to ensure that the software is functioning correctly and that all requirements have been met.

Defect Management: Documenting and tracking defects found during testing, as well as working with developers to resolve them.

Collaboration: A QA Engineer should be able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and project managers, to ensure that software products meet customer needs and are delivered on time.

Continuous Improvement: Should be committed to continuous learning and improvement, staying up\-to\-date with the latest testing tools and methodologies and continuously improving the testing process.

Documentation: A QA Engineer is responsible for creating and maintaining documentation of the testing process and test results, as well as reporting progress and results to the project team and stakeholders.

title: AI Data Quality and Verification Associate Intern
description:
**About the Company**

We are a fast\-growing AI solutions company that automates responses to Requests for Information (RFIs) from customers, with a focus on sustainability, compliance, and product specifications. Our systems use advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models to generate accurate, context\-rich responses. To maintain the highest quality, we are building a human\-in\-the\-loop data team to support and improve AI output.

**About the Internship \+ Full\-Time Opportunity**

This is a 1\-month internship program for fresh graduates who want to start a career in AI support, data quality, and document review.

* During this internship, you will learn how our AI workflow functions, including how information is extracted, organized, and reviewed for accuracy. You will also get an introduction to how AI models improve through feedback, how RAG\-based systems retrieve information, and how data quality affects the final answers.
* You will work with sample datasets and example documents to practice reviewing extracted content, correcting system mistakes, and checking AI\-generated answers.
* Your learning speed, communication, attention to detail, and ability to follow structured processes will be monitored throughout the internship.
* Candidates who **perform well** will receive a **full\-time offer** for the Data Associate role, where they will begin collaborating directly with QA and tech teams.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. RFI Question Extraction \& Verification**

* Identify and extract questions from customer\-submitted RFI documents (PDFs, Word, Excel, etc.)
* Categorize and structure questions accurately under the guidance of domain experts
* Ensure completeness and clarity of extracted data

**2\. Digitized Document Format Review**

* Review digitized versions of documents for formatting errors, misinterpretations, and incomplete data capture
* Make corrections and annotate issues to improve data quality for the AI training process
* Assist in maintaining metadata such as document type, language, and structure

**3\. AI Answer Review**

* Evaluate answers generated by the AI model based on accuracy, relevance, and clarity
* Highlight incorrect, ambiguous, or missing responses and suggest better alternatives
* Tag responses as Verified / Needs Review / Incorrect based on defined quality standards

**4\. Reporting \& Collaboration**

* Document and report issues found during data extraction, verification, or AI output evaluation
* Communicate clearly with development and QA teams to relay edge cases or repeated issues
* Assist in creating feedback loops to help the AI system learn from human corrections

**Qualifications** **Required**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to spot mistakes.
* Basic analytical thinking and problem\-solving mindset.
* Good command of English language – both written and comprehension
* Comfortable working with documents in various formats and using basic tools (Google Docs, Sheets, PDFs,MS Office tools)

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with ChatGPT or other AI tools is a plus
* Interest in AI, document processing, or quality control
* Interest in understanding how AI improves through feedback.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Document interpretation and summarization
* Basic understanding of data accuracy and formatting
* Communication and teamwork
* Initiative and adaptability in fast\-paced environments

**What We Offer:**

* 1\-Month Internship with potential Full\-Time Offer based on performance
* Competitive fresher salary with performance\-based incentives
* Work with cutting\-edge AI systems
* Mentorship from experienced AI/QA professionals
* Friendly environment
* Chance to own responsibility and demonstrate accountability
* Flexible Work Arrangements: Onsite or remote options (as per company policy).
* International horizons – work with international teams and clients from all corners of the world
* Company parties, team events and the opportunity to work with great colleagues from all over the world
* Medical Insurance

**Location \& Work Mode**: Remote/Hybrid

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Are you aware that this is a non\-technical role and does not lead to a technical career path?

title: Electrical Technician
description:
Job Summary:

The Projection Technician is responsible for the smooth operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of digital cinema projection and sound systems. The role requires a strong electrician background to handle electrical systems, safety compliance, and technical coordination to ensure uninterrupted and high\-quality movie presentation at PVR Cinemas.

Key Responsibilities:Projection \& Audio Systems:

* Operate and monitor digital cinema projectors (DCP), servers, and sound systems.
* Ensure accurate show scheduling, content loading, and playback as per show timings.
* Perform regular checks to maintain picture and sound quality.

Electrical \& Technical Maintenance:

* Handle electrical wiring, panels, UPS, stabilizers, and power distribution related to projection systems.
* Diagnose and rectify electrical faults affecting projection, sound, or related equipment.
* Carry out preventive maintenance of projection rooms and technical equipment.

Equipment Maintenance:

* Perform routine cleaning, calibration, and maintenance of projectors and lenses.
* Coordinate with vendors/service engineers for major repairs and AMC\-related activities.
* Maintain proper logs for breakdowns, servicing, and spare parts usage.

Safety \& Compliance:

* Follow electrical safety norms, fire safety standards, and company SOPs.
* Ensure proper earthing, insulation, and safe handling of electrical equipment.
* Support statutory audits and safety inspections.

Coordination \& Support:

* Coordinate with cinema operations, housekeeping, and security teams during shows.
* Provide technical support during premieres, special screenings, and live events.
* Respond promptly to technical emergencies during operational hours.

Qualifications:

* ITI / Diploma in Electrician or equivalent technical qualification.
* Certification or experience in electrical maintenance is mandatory.
* Knowledge of digital cinema projection systems is preferred (training will be provided if required).

Experience:

* 1–3 years of experience in electrical maintenance, preferably in cinemas, theaters, malls, hotels, or similar environments.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹380,000\.00 per year

title: Transportation Specialist I, ROC
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About Amazon ROC (Relay Operation Centre):
  

Join a team that offers best learning opportunities and work experience in transportation execution, supply chain and operations management. A place where you can start/restart/advance your career and progress to leadership roles at Amazon.
  

ROC (Relay Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. In addition to support provided for ATS organization This organization supports externalization of ROC capabilities to external shippers and vendors.
  

Along with this tactical problem\-solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
  

Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation network and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  

  

Location: Bangalore, KA IND  

  

Hours of Operation/Shift Timings: Rotational shifts (Position involves rotational shifts to support 24/7 operations. Schedule accommodations will be considered based on individual needs  

Medium of support: Multi\-mode (Voice and non\-voice)  

  

A synopsis of a ‘Transportation Specialist’ role:
  

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (  

Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Transportation Specialist at ROC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
  

* Inbound (IB) Operations deals with Vendor/Shipper/Carrier/Amazon Sites relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked\-up on time and is delivered at destination sites as per the given appointment.
* Outbound (OB) Operations deals with Amazon Sites/Carrier/Carrier Hub/Shipper destination sites relationship, ensuring that the outbound truck leaves Amazon sites/Shipper origin sites to deliver customer orders as per promise.
* Transportation Specialists addresses any potential issues such as appointment bookings, reschedules, in\-transit disruptions, weather impact situations etc. occurring during the lifecycle of pick\-up to delivery.
* In addition to the IB or OB operations, transportation specialists support variety of tasks such as load scheduling, load cancelations, supporting network capacity management, coordinating with non\-Amazon transportation organization such as rail, sea organizations, manage remote gate\-houses, managing equipment availability, equipment maintenance and such.

  

A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real\-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements from sites/carriers/shippers/drivers and be able to analyze data and effectively communicate the resolution or actions with an effort to meet the network speed and customer promise. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Transportation Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Communicate with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers, Shippers, Drivers) and internal customers (Amazon sites, business teams and stakeholders)
* Maintain high\-standards of quality and productivity standards in all transactions or conversations
* Must be able to understand the size of problem and systemically escalate problems to the relevant owners and teams and follow through the closure of the issues
* Core responsibilities include working with Amazon Internal tools, MS Outlook, Word and Excel
* Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions in the best interest of customers and the organization based on available data.
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs
* The organizational support runs across rotational shifts (24\*7, 365 days) to support NA and EU regions. Candidates are expected to be flexible with such requirements while there are reasonable accommodations for employees with special circumstances.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent training or certifications
* Must be a graduate or post graduate
* 0–5 years of experience in customer support/operations support
* Freshers with no experience must have strong English communication skills through various means (verbal, written, or assisted communication methods)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with Excel

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-First Mindset: A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

 **NOTE**


Comfortable working in a hybrid office environment (3 days minimum) plus working US\-business hours (EST/PST time zones).

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai . description:
**About Us** 




 Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (‘‘Jefferies,’’ ‘‘we,’’ ‘‘us’’ or ‘‘our’’) is a U.S.\-headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U.S. broker\-dealer, was founded in the U.S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U.K. broker\-dealer, was established in the U.K. in 1986\. Our strategy focuses on continuing to build out our investment banking effort, enhancing our capital markets businesses and further developing our Leucadia Asset Management alternative asset management platform. We offer deep sector expertise across a full range of products and services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset and wealth management in the Americas, Europe and the Middle East and Asia.
 



  





**Position: HRBP \- Associate (Based in Express Towers, Mumbai)** 




**Description:** 
 The HRBP\- Associate will be responsible for delivering proactive and high\-quality operational HR support to Jefferies India. The candidate will support the overall Jefferies India HR Head in providing a variety of HR services to the business. The HR Business Partner will act as a trusted advisor and will provide support to the business across the full range of HR disciplines such as recruitment including campus recruitment support, onboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, regulatory reporting and audit requirements, employee relations, talent development and employee engagement.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities:** 
 The HRBP Associate will report to the Jefferies India HR Head. Responsibilities include the following across JIPL (India front office) and JISPL (Mumbai Services entity) :
 



  




* Act as the primary HR Business Partner across various parts of the organization offering mentorship coordination, career development support, and serving as their main point of HR contact.
* Provide operational support to the India HR team across cyclical and ad hoc HR processes, including performance management, promotions, compensation, and talent development.
* Respond to employee and manager inquiries with accurate, timely, and thorough guidance on topics such as policies, immigration and employment verifications.
* Support the recruitment and campus teams to hire top talent, compensation proposals in line with market, head count approval management and support campus on the ground with Superday activities etc.
* Maintain data integrity by ensuring HR systems are updated accurately and promptly.
* Generate and manage HR analytics reports covering headcount, hiring, terminations, recruiting metrics, and other key data points.
* Support the onboarding and offboarding process for both voluntary and involuntary terminations.
* Proactively support HR regulatory filings plus audits and collaborate with various teams to maintain compliance with local regulatory requirements
* Foster cultural engagement by helping organize team\-building events and volunteer initiatives to strengthen cross\-team connectivity.
* Conduct new hire check\-ins to facilitate integration, address challenges, and gather feedback on the employee experience.
* Help drive the year\-end promotions process by managing timelines, tracking global nominations, compiling year\-over\-year statistics, and overseeing communications.
* Manage employee relations cases as required in partnership with HR management and employment legal counsel.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, escalating issues as needed based on day\-to\-day transactional insights.



  





**Desired Experience/Skills:** 



* Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degrees in human resources, psychology, or related fields preferred.
* 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in a HR Business partnership role in matrixed global organization in Financial services.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong Excel skills required (must be fluent in formulas such as VLOOKUP, PivotTables, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, MIN, MAX, AVERAGE).
* Comfortable learning and navigating systems; prior experience with HRIS is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Precise attention to detail and strong process orientation and project management skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a client service mindset.
* Positive attitude with a desire to learn and grow.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, professionalism and assertiveness with the ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Collaborative team player who takes initiative and proactively contributes ideas and recommendations.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity work environment.



  





 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.

We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Human Resources Business Partner - APAC
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Human Resources Business Partner – APAC (India and Australia) will serve as a hands\-on HR partner supporting leadership teams across India and Australia, responsible for end\-to\-end HR support while strengthening talent management practices.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Global CHRO of DeepHealth, this role will operate as part of the global HR leadership structure, partnering closely with regional HR Business Partners and business leaders to ensure alignment of talent strategy, performance discipline, and governance standards across regions.
   

  

 The HRBP will partner closely with leaders across India and Australia. The role requires a pragmatic HR leader who can operate both strategically and operationally, with the ability to execute independently in a global matrix environment.
   

  

 This position is primarily an HRBP role with additional responsibility for talent management, including performance discipline, manager capability, and development planning. The individual will strengthen talent attraction, mid\-career development, high\-potential identification, structured career pathing, and succession sequencing while ensuring disciplined implementation of enterprise HR frameworks.
   

  

 The role requires a pragmatic HR leader who can operate hands\-on, provide clear guidance to leaders, and execute talent and people initiatives in a global matrix environment.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Partner with business leaders to understand organizational needs and provide clear, actionable HR guidance aligned with business priorities.
* Able to translate workforce strategy into practical organizational actions, supporting leadership teams on organizational design, talent planning, and capability development.
* Serve as the primary HRBP for India, supporting leaders on employee relations, performance management, compensation decisions, organizational design, and workforce planning.
* Provide hands\-on execution across the employee lifecycle including hiring support, onboarding, performance documentation, and offboarding.
* Assess external talent ecosystems, including university pipelines, industry talent networks, and potential partner organizations, to strengthen long\-term talent attraction strategy.
* Design and implement structured career frameworks, competency models, and progression standards for technical and mid\-career talent.
* Support leadership teams in developing stronger manager capability for coaching, performance feedback, and career development of technical professionals.
* Lead and execute talent reviews, succession planning processes, and high\-potential identification with measurable follow\-through.
* Strengthen compensation governance and promotion sequencing to ensure disciplined and equitable talent decisions.
* Build retention strategies informed by workforce analytics, engagement trends, and attrition insights.
* Elevate recruiting discipline and talent acquisition quality, including direct sourcing for hard\-to\-fill roles; demonstrated hands\-on proficiency using LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search is required.
* Define and institutionalize candidate evaluation standards, pipeline strategy, and onboarding quality frameworks to improve hiring effectiveness.
* Define and operationalize employment and compensation governance frameworks to ensure consistency, scalability, and regulatory alignment.
* Monitor workforce metrics including retention, engagement, mobility, and promotion velocity, providing data\-driven recommendations to leadership.
* Align regional employment practices with Indian labor regulations and global HR governance standards, in partnership with HR Operations and Legal.
* Collaborate with global HR leadership to implement enterprise talent initiatives locally and contribute to broader talent framework development.
* Collaborate closely with regional HR partners and business leaders to ensure alignment of talent strategy and people priorities across regions.
* Operate effectively in a global matrix environment, aligning with centralized HR governance and global practices.


 PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications, Education And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with significant experience operating as a hands\-on HR Business Partner in India
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior business leaders and owning HR outcomes end\-to\-end
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and employment practices, with experience managing complex employee relations matters independently
* Demonstrated experience supporting recruiting efforts, including direct sourcing using LinkedIn Recruiter and partnership with hiring managers on difficult\-to\-fill roles
* Experience supporting performance management cycles, including calibration discussions, performance documentation, and manager coaching
* Exposure to compensation governance, including leveling, internal equity considerations, and promotion decisions
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization with alignment to centralized HR governance
* Strong verbal communication skills with ability to communicate clearly and concisely with business leaders
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience directly supporting Australia\-based employees in an HRBP capacity
* Experience supporting technical, product, or R\&D teams
* Experience working in a distributed APAC environment
* Experience operating in a scaling or high\-growth organization
* Demonstrated experience driving talent management initiatives such as succession discussions, development planning, and manager capability


**Quality Standards**
* Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co\-workers, visitors, and vendors.
* Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
* Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
* Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
* Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
* Practices universal safety precautions.
* Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
* Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
* Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
* Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.
